changes.current_line: Online and in-store on one platform; the line between them has pretty much disappeared.
changes.change: For retailers with physical stores: One system for the tills and the website, with one vendor accountable for both.
changes.why: The buyer described the need as one system for tills and web with one accountable vendor, and our abstract M3 line got silence and was called 'a diagram', so their wording should replace ours.

changes.change: For retailers with physical stores: Show the holiday scenario live. Buy online, return at a store till, and watch the order and customer record match, step by step.
changes.why: The buyer asked to watch an online order returned at a till live, and we only described it, while the web demo that landed was a different buyer's interest.

changes.change: For store rollouts: Every proposal names one person from our side who owns installs and rollout, so the answer is never 'we'll bring in a partner'.
changes.why: When the buyer asked who does the installs we answered 'a partner', her questions stopped, and we had no store rollout experience to back up a different answer.

changes.current_line: Trusted by leading businesses; see our customer stories.
changes.change: Talk to a live reference before you decide: we'll set up a call with a retailer that runs our tills and web.
changes.why: The buyer asked to speak with a customer directly, and we sent a case study and missed the reference call, so offering a live reference is the proof they asked for.
